title: PRINCIPLES OF  MANAGERIAL ACCOUNTING
description: Builds an understanding of the role of managerial accounting in a business, focusing on the development and use of information to evaluate production costs and operational performance in support of short- and long-term organizational decision-making.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 211Z, 211HZ, 211 or 211H.
A minimum grade of C- is required in BA 211Z, BA 211HZ, BA 211 and BA 211H.
meeting_html: T 10am-10:50am in AUST 222 - Austin Hall 222 (9/23 to 12/4)
